Class EditMemory.Span

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.edit.EditMemory.Span
Enclosing class:
EditMemory
private static final class EditMemory.Span extends Object
The Span type is one queued insert or remove. The EditMemory.drain() method writes the span onto the undo stack. The offset is the start of the change in the text before it. The removed text is empty on an insert. The inserted text is empty on a remove.

      private Span(int offset, String removed, String inserted, int cursorBefore, int cursorAfter)
      The constructor stores one queued change.
      Parameters:
      offset - The start of the change in the text before it.
      removed - The text that left, or empty on an insert.
      inserted - The text that arrived, or empty on a remove.
      cursorBefore - The caret before the change.
      cursorAfter - The caret after the change.
